==Television==
This season saw the first ever live television coverage of a Football League game, when [[ITV (TV channel)|ITV]] broadcast the second half of [[Blackpool F.C.|Blackpool]] versus [[Bolton Wanderers F.C|Bolton Wanderers]] on September 10, 1960, with commentary from [[Peter Lloyd (commentator)|Peter Lloyd]] and [[Billy_Wright_(footballer,_born_1924)|Billy Wright]]<ref>{{cite news|date=September 12, 1960|title=TV Makes Pitch 200 Yards Wide!|first=Frank|last=McGhee|newspaper=[[Daily Mirror]]|page=25}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.thesportsman.com/features/why-did-itv-fail-in-its-bid-to-bring-us-live-saturday-night-football-in-the-1960s |title=Saturday Night Live: Remembering ITV's Failed Football Experiment |last=Crist |first=Matthew |date=September 19, 2019 |website=The Sportsman |access-date=April 8, 2021}}</ref>
